label: automatic recording of events (logs)
definition: High-risk AI systems must technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system.

label: logging capabilities
definition: Capabilities enabling the recording of events relevant for identifying risks, facilitating post-market monitoring, and monitoring operation of high-risk AI systems.
source_quote: logging capabilities shall enable the recording of events relevant for: identifying situations that may result in the high-risk AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1) or in a substantial modification; facilitating the post-market monitoring referred to in Article 72; and monitoring the operation of high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 26(5).

label: recording of the period of each use
definition: Logging capabilities must provide recording of the start date and time, end date and time for each use of the system.
source_quote: recording of the period of each use of the system (start date and time and end date and time of each use)

label: reference database against which input data has been checked
definition: Logging capabilities must provide the reference database against which input data has been checked by the system.
source_quote: the reference database against which input data has been checked by the system

label: input data for which the search has led to a match
definition: Logging capabilities must provide the input data for which the search has led to a match.
source_quote: the input data for which the search has led to a match

label: identification of natural persons involved in verification
definition: Logging capabilities must provide the identification of the natural persons involved in the verification of the results.
source_quote: the identification of the natural persons involved in the verification of the results, as referred to in Article 14(5)
